sentences.text: FDA's drug shortage list does not include cefepime as of 2026-10-21.
Corvale East holds 95 vials of the 2 g injection with 5.5 days of supply at current use.
Corvale General holds 321 vials of the same presentation with 20.2 days of supply.
The top-ranked option by rule is to transfer 99 vials of 2 g from Corvale General to Corvale East.
Corvale General can spare 99 vials while retaining at least two weeks of inventory.
After the transfer Corvale East would have approximately 11 days of supply.
